tasks.title: Baseline, re-ground scope, and record name-level inventory
tasks.description:
Context: OpenSpec change decompose-large-test-files (#8), tasks 1.1-1.3. This is the deliberately-last decomposition, planned for a post-#5/#6/#7 world; those production layouts land before this queue runs. design.md Decisions 4 and 5 govern: the acceptance criterion is an EMPTY test grandfather map, not a fixed file list, and the move-and-verify inventory is the gate. Re-ground against the tree as it actually is now — do not trust the proposal's baseline line numbers.

Outcome: A confirmed-green tree, a recorded current target list (every _test.go entry in the archguard grandfather map), a per-package pre-change name-level function inventory, and the mirror-target file lists (#6's recorded runner files, #7's per-package files) captured for the downstream split laps and the final comparison.

Files & scope: No source edits in this lap — it runs commands and records artifacts only. Save the inventory/scope/mirror-target snapshots to a scratch file under openspec/changes/decompose-large-test-files/ (input for task 4.2's comparison), not a freeform report.

Design: Run go build ./..., go test -count=1 ./..., go test -race -shuffle=on -count=1 ./internal/relay/... ./internal/config ./internal/store, and go run ./tools/archguard --ci (exit 0). If any test fails under -shuffle=on BEFORE a single move, STOP and report — a pre-existing ordering defect is not this change's to fix silently. Regenerate the map with go run ./tools/archguard --report; the authoritative scope is exactly the _test.go entries it lists (eight at the f55712c baseline, minus any suite #5/#6/#7 already split when they ran). Record per-package inventory with grep -hoE '^func (Test|Benchmark|Fuzz)[A-Za-z0-9_]*' <files> | sort. Read #6's recorded runner file list and #7's per-package lists as the mirror axes each split lap will follow.

Acceptance: Green baseline confirmed; scope list, per-package inventories, and #6/#7 mirror-target file lists recorded and available to the split laps. Do NOT tick tasks.md — verification is the gate for that.

tasks.title: Split resilience_test.go by resilience concern
tasks.description:
Context: task 2.1. internal/relay/resilience_test.go has NO upstream dependency and can land first. design.md Decision 2 gives the split axis.

Outcome: resilience_test.go split into responsibility-named _test.go files in internal/relay, each under the 1,000-line cap, grouped by resilience concern: state machine/persistence vs stall/frozen transitions vs benched/probation/decay. Shared fixtures/builders extracted into a single per-package helper test file (extend an existing one; create at most one new helper_test.go if none exists).

Files & scope: internal/relay/*_test.go only. Zero production-file edits — not even renames. A test spanning multiple concerns goes with the behaviour it primarily pins; never split a single test function.

Design: Arrangement only — no assertion, fixture-meaning, or coverage change; extract only verbatim-shared setup, leave case-local variants inline (Decision 3). Move-and-verify inventory per commit (Decision 4): grep the Test*/Benchmark*/Fuzz* names for the package before and after; the multiset must be identical, each declared exactly once. Helper files are subject to the 1,000-line cap too.

Acceptance: go test -race -shuffle=on -count=1 ./internal/relay green; before/after name inventory identical; one commit for this suite. Report the resulting file list. Do not tick tasks.md.

tasks.title: Verify the stable-package suite splits (tasks 2.1-2.3)
tasks.description:
Context: verification gate at the stable-package slice boundary, covering tasks 2.1 (resilience), 2.2 (config), 2.3 (store). Use the openspec-verify-change skill against decompose-large-test-files, then focus the report on these three suites.

Outcome: Confirmation that the three stable-package suites are correctly and thoroughly split, arrangement-only, with preserved inventories — or head laps for any gap.

Scope & method: Identify the intended merge target (ask the user / PR metadata / branch config / recent history — do not assume main) and the first lap/try in this batch; treat earlier branch work as pre-existing. Trace real evidence, not just green tests: compare the per-package before/after Test*/Benchmark*/Fuzz* inventories from the baseline snapshot (identical multiset, each declared once); confirm every new internal/relay, internal/config, internal/store _test.go file is under 1,000 lines; confirm the diff for these suites touches only _test.go files (zero production edits, no assertion changes). Run go test -race -shuffle=on -count=1 ./internal/relay ./internal/config ./internal/store.

Acceptance: If solid, check the tasks.md boxes for 2.1-2.3. For any substantive gap, add a focused head lap (additive/revert commits only — never rewrite git history) rather than fixing large work inline; only tiny safe one-liners may be fixed here. Report findings first.

tasks.title: Ratchet the archguard baseline and verify the full change
tasks.description:
Context: tasks 3.4, 3.5, and phase 4 (4.1-4.4) plus the whole-change gate. Covers the last two runner splits and the ratchet+verification. Use the openspec-verify-change skill for the full change decompose-large-test-files and inspect the entire diff. design.md Decision 5: the acceptance criterion is the EMPTY test grandfather map, not a fixed file list.

Outcome: The #3 test grandfather map is empty, the whole change is confirmed arrangement-only with preserved inventories, and every suite is under the cap — or head laps for any gap.

Scope & method: First verify 3.4 (relay_steps) and 3.5 (runner_failure_telemetry) like the earlier runner gate — inventory preserved, files under cap, _test.go-only diff, package tests green under -race -shuffle=on. Then the ratchet: regenerate the baseline with go run ./tools/archguard --report and confirm ZERO _test.go grandfather entries remain, every new _test.go file (helpers included) is under 1,000 lines, and go run ./tools/archguard --ci exits 0 with NO policy-table edit (baseline regeneration only, per the #4/#6 precedent). Final inventory comparison per package against the baseline lap's snapshot: identical multisets, each Test/Benchmark/Fuzz declared exactly once. Full verification: go test -count=1 ./..., go test -race -shuffle=on -count=1 ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l . empty, just check green. Confirm the whole diff touches only _test.go files plus the regenerated baseline — zero production-file edits, no assertion changes, internal/buildinfo/VERSION untouched, no version bump/release. Identify the intended merge target (do not assume main) and this batch's first lap/try; treat earlier work as pre-existing.

Acceptance: If everything holds, check the remaining tasks.md boxes (1.1-1.3, 3.4, 3.5, 4.1-4.4). Add focused head laps for substantive gaps (additive/revert commits only, never rewrite history); only tiny safe one-liners inline. Report findings first.
